headlines.title: 上海：加快推进收购二手住房用作保障性租赁住房
headlines.summary: 8月20日，上海市住房城乡建设管理委、市房屋管理局、市财政局、人民银行上海市分行、上海金融监管局、市公积金管理中心等六部门联合印发《关于优化本市房地产政策措施的通知》，自2026年8月21日起施行。《通知》规定，以需求为导向，结合“十五五”时期保障性租赁住房发展要求，各中心城区（含浦东外环内区域）推进二手住房收购工作，并加快改造出租，切实增加中心城区保障性租赁住房供应。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Accelerating the purchase of second-hand homes for use as affordable rental housing
headlines.summary_en: On Aug 20, six Shanghai agencies including the Municipal Commission of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Housing Administration Bureau, the Finance Bureau, the PBOC Shanghai Branch, the Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau and the Municipal Housing Provident Fund Management Center jointly issued the "Notice on Optimizing Municipal Real Estate Policy Measures," effective Aug 21, 2026. The notice states that demand-oriented, in line with the "15th Five-Year Plan" period's development requirements for affordable rental housing, central urban districts (including areas inside the Outer Ring Road in Pudong) will advance the acquisition of second-hand homes and accelerate renovation for leasing to effectively increase the supply of affordable rental housing in central urban areas.

headlines.title: 上海市调整商业性个人住房贷款最低首付比例政策

headlines.title_en: Shanghai adjusts minimum down payment ratio policy for commercial personal housing loans
headlines.summary_en: The PBOC Shanghai Branch and the Shanghai Office of the National Financial Regulatory Administration jointly issued the "Notice on Adjusting the Minimum Down Payment Ratio Policy for Commercial Personal Housing Loans in Shanghai," making the following adjustments to Shanghai's commercial personal housing loan policy: optimize personal housing credit policy and lower the minimum down payment ratio for second-home loans. For homes purchased outside the Outer Ring Road (including areas previously subject to differentiated policies), the minimum down payment ratio for second-home commercial personal housing loans is adjusted to 15%, and to 25% for other areas. Banking institutions should reasonably determine the specific down payment ratio for each loan based on the minimum requirements set in this notice, their own operating conditions, and customer risk profiles. headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Introducing phased home purchase subsidy policies
headlines.summary_en: First, implement a "trade-in" home purchase loan subsidy. From the effective date of this Notice until March 31, 2027, households purchasing new commercial housing outside the Outer Ring Road with completed online contract filing, and selling their Shanghai second-hand home within one year before or after the filing date, may apply to the district real estate transaction center where the new home is located for a subsidy. The subsidy is calculated at 1% of the total loan amount for the new home purchase, capped at RMB 50,000 per unit; the total subsidy pool is RMB 200 million, available on a first-come, first-served basis until exhausted.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Optimizing housing provident fund withdrawal policies
headlines.summary_en: First, expand the scope of withdrawing housing provident fund for down payment payments. Based on the August 2025 "Shanghai Six Measures" supporting contributors purchasing new pre-sold commercial housing in the city with provident fund withdrawals for down payments, the scope is further expanded to include new completed commercial housing; continued support for "both withdrawal and lending" means that withdrawing for a down payment does not affect the calculation of the contributor's provident fund loan quota.

headlines.title_en: Germany's July producer price growth hits a new high in over three years
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data Aug 20 - Germany's Federal Statistical Office said Germany's July producer price growth hit a three-year high, driven by rising intermediate goods and energy costs, signaling that inflation pressures are re-emerging. Prices charged by manufacturers for food, industrial products and other goods rose 3.0% year-on-year, above the 2.7% analysts expected. This is the largest producer price increase since April 2023 and a clear acceleration from June's 1.8% rise. German producer prices rose 1.1% month-on-month in July. Alexander Krueger, chief economist at Germany's Bethmann Bank, said: "The situation at the early stage of the inflation surge is suddenly becoming concerning. The impact of the Iran war is showing, and so is the impact of the heatwave." The Rhine River's water level has remained at historic lows for weeks, hampering shipping on Germany's most important inland waterway and pushing up transport costs.

headlines.title_en: A-share market close: ChiNext Index rebounded on shrinking volume, up 0.64%; biopharmaceutical stocks surged collectively
headlines.summary_en: Markets opened higher but pulled back through the session, with the three major indices posting modest gains. Biopharmaceutical stocks surged collectively, with Sanyuan Gene, CSPC Innovation, Anke Biotech and others hitting the daily limit. Precious metals sector rallied, with Shenzhen Zhongheng Huafa and Nan Kuang Group hitting limit up. CPO concept stocks were active, with Zhongjin Electronics hitting the limit up, and T&S Communications and Linktel Technologies rising over 10%. On the downside, the commercial aerospace concept declined, with SJK Co., Ltd. and Fiwo Technology falling over 10%. Advancers outnumbered decliners, with over 4,000 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets trading higher, and turnover reached 2.09 trillion yuan today. At the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.24%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 0.59%, and the ChiNext Index rose 0.64%.
